faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist position at JNCASR is September 7, 2026. Candidates are urged to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist role, candidates must possess a BTech, MSc, or MTech degree in Biological Sciences. This ensures that applicants have the necessary technical and scientific background.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist position is 35 years. Specific age relaxations may apply for certain categories as per government rules, so it's advisable to check the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist post will receive a salary of Rs. 4.34 lakh per annum. This is a competitive salary package offered by JNCASR for this contract role.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist post at the Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR). This single opening presents a focused opportunity for qualified individuals.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the JNCASR ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website or use the provided link to submit their applications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist position at JNCASR is a contract-based job. This means the employment is for a fixed tenure, offering valuable experience in a research environment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist role involves an online interview, a technical discussion, and a personal interaction. These stages are designed to assess the candidate's suitability and expertise.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without incurring any charges, making the application process more accessible.

faq.answer: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR) is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560064. This ensures that candidates applying are aware of the geographical location of the institution.
